name: A Hollow Harvest
summary:
First it went for the livestock, now it's after the villagers.

You find yourself in a quiet little village. After inheriting an old farm from a deceased brother, a family reaches out for your help to find out what's responsible-but the investigation isn't easy; someone locked everything up. Search a dead man's belongings and penetrate his secrets one lock at a time-but hurry, bodies are piling up by the day. Your decisions will affect the fate of who lives and who dies for different potential endings-as well as several death scenes along the way, if you aren't careful.

Features custom art, atmospheric storytelling and plenty of scares! (This is the fourth game in the NOT ALL THERE series, but you can play them in any order.)
